content: DuckDB-Wasm runs fully in-browser WebAssembly memory, which has practical ceilings well below native (users report OOM errors around 2M+ rows / ~2GB+ loaded data even with data under theoretical WASM limits); temp_directory / disk-spill settings that let native DuckDB spill to disk on OOM have limited or no effect in the WASM/browser sandbox, so large datasets can hit hard OOM failures instead of graceful degradation.
